description: MCP server exposing LS증권 OpenAPI (REST) as tools. Read-only Korean stock market data and analysis via natural language.
releaseNotes: v0.10.1 (patch over 0.10.0): Fixes the MCP Registry publish — .mcp/server.json's description exceeded the registry's 100-character limit (HTTP 422). Also caps ls_get_etf_holdings' default top_n at 20 (was unbounded) so an un-capped call on a large ETF no longer dumps 20k+ tokens into context. v0.10.0 (BREAKING) folded 20 portfolio tools into 5 action-routed dispatchers + added the LS_TOOL_PROFILE env var. See https://github.com/redoxnet/mcp-lsopenapi/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.Mcp.md.
